description: The error, URL, web-session adapter, and capability-revision contracts extracted from the workspace and billing clients. Also the generated @comfyorg/ingest-types API types and Zod schemas. ComfyUI backend wire schemas remain in comfyui-api. Other ingest transport files remain unclassified.

characterizationScenarios.name: Ingest errors preserve HTTP status, operation, and workspace-access refusal identity
Ingest URLs select the cloud API or configured local ingest host
The web-session adapter preserves Axios request and response behavior
Mutation responses publish capability revisions without publishing query revisions
Generated ingest types and Zod schemas describe the same contract, and response schemas tolerate fields the server adds later

compatibilityPromises: WorkspaceApiError and NoWorkspaceAccessError retain shared runtime identity across billing and workspace clients.

Other domains import only the characterized public contracts: the ingest error, URL, web-session, and capability-revision modules, and the @comfyorg/ingest-types type and Zod entries. Other ingest modules are not opened by this record.
